title: BIS Conformity Assessment Scheme Decision Tree

step_2_domestic.question: What product category does your item belong to?

options.label: IT Hardware, Laptops, Mobile Handsets, or Solar PV
Industrial Goods, Pressure Cookers, Helmets, Steel, Cement, or Electrical Appliances
Textiles, Furniture, or General Unregulated Consumer Goods

step_3_factory_testing.question: Does your factory possess an in-house laboratory matching BIS Scheme of Testing and Inspection (STI)?

options.label: Yes, we have / can establish the required in-house test setup
No, we are a micro-enterprise relying entirely on external testing

result_scheme1_normal.description: Applicable for mandatory QCO items (e.g., IS 2347 for Pressure Cookers, IS 4151 for Helmets, IS 269 for Cement). Requires factory audit, sample sealing, and continuous in-house testing equipment.
result_scheme1_normal.msme_benefit: 80% concession on application and annual license fee for micro-enterprises and women startups.

result_scheme1_simplified.description: Grant of license within 30 days based on prior testing from a BIS-recognized NABL lab, followed by verification audit.

result_crs.route_type: Self-Declaration of Conformity (SDoC) via NABL Test Report
result_crs.description: Mandated by MeitY / MNRE for electronic items, lithium cells, power banks, and solar modules. No factory audit required before grant.
result_crs.msme_benefit: No factory audit inspection fee; entirely paperless digital registration.

result_fmcs.route_type: Physical Overseas Factory Inspection + India Authorized Representative (AIR)
result_fmcs.description: Required for foreign manufacturing units exporting ISI mark mandatory goods to India. Requires appointment of an Authorized Indian Representative (AIR).
result_fmcs.msme_benefit: Allows legitimate direct entry into Indian domestic markets.

result_hallmarking.description: Mandatory 6-digit alphanumeric HUID laser marking for 14K, 18K, 20K, 22K, 23K, and 24K gold articles. Jeweller registers online without physical factory audit.
result_hallmarking.msme_benefit: Free registration for micro-jewellers with turnover below specified limits.

result_voluntary.description: Your product currently does not fall under an active mandatory Gazette Quality Control Order (QCO). You may voluntarily apply for ISI mark to build consumer trust, or sell without mandatory certification.
result_voluntary.msme_benefit: Zero mandatory compliance barrier to begin selling.
